## 1. Introduction

Explain what the topic is in plain English, why it matters, and what everyday problem it helps solve.

## 2. Learning Objectives

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

- Define the core concept in plain language.
- Trace how the idea works step by step on a small example.
- Spot a common misconception and explain the accurate behavior.

## 3. Intuitive Explanation

Start with a relatable real-world analogy or tiny concrete example before introducing formal terms.

<Callout type="note" title="Key Concept Summary">
  Highlight a short mental anchor or distinction that helps beginners avoid confusion.
</Callout>
